en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a street scene with three men in traditional Albanian costume seen from the back, walking in a muddy road among a crowd of people. The setting appears to be an early‑20th‑century city with low buildings in the background. Printed French text at the top identifies the location as Salonique (Thessaloniki) and notes the Albanian costume; small publisher text is at the bottom left, and a modern website watermark appears at the bottom right.
